papers.title: Microstructural design of Ni-base alloys for high-temperature applications: impact of heat treatment on microstructure and mechanical properties after selective laser melting

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究镍基高温合金的热处理对微观结构和力学性能的影响，与生物医学植入物设计或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper investigates Ni-base superalloys for high-temperature applications, not biomedical implants; it lacks porous structure design, stress shielding analysis, fatigue testing, and osseointegration considerations.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化镍基高温合金的微观结构以提高高温力学性能
summary_zh.method: 对选区激光熔化制备的镍基合金进行不同热处理并表征微观结构
summary_zh.result: 热处理显著影响γ'相析出和力学性能，实现了强度与塑性的平衡
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜和拉伸测试验证微观结构与力学性能的关系

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to optimize the microstructure of Ni-base superalloys fabricated by selective laser melting for enhanced high-temperature mechanical performance.
summary_en.method: Different heat treatments were applied to as-built SLM Ni-base alloys, and the resulting microstructures were characterized using SEM and EBSD.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment significantly influenced γ' precipitate morphology and mechanical properties, achieving a balance between strength and ductility.
summary_en.validation: The relationship between microstructure and mechanical properties was validated through tensile testing and microstructural analysis.
